title: MEIKO — Happy Anniversary!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: VIRTUAL SINGER Stage

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Thank you all so much for coming to see MEIKO's anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Thanks to all of you watching the stream too!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Now, let's get today's star on the stage so we can get this show started.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Sounds like a plan! Everyone, are you ready?!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Alright, let's start the countdown!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Audience
rows.Line: Ten!

rows.Speaker: Rin & Audience
rows.Line: Nine!

rows.Speaker: Len & Audience
rows.Line: Eight!

rows.Speaker: Luka & Audience
rows.Line: Seven!

rows.Speaker: KAITO & Audience
rows.Line: Six!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Five!! Four!! Three!! Two!! One!!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Zero!!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO!!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hello, everyone in the audience!
And hello to everyone watching the stream!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you for coming to my anniversary show!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I'd like to start with this song...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you all again for coming to see my anniversary show...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Look at all the comments everybody left while watching the stream, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Oh wow! So many comments...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Whoa! There's too many to look at all at once!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Yeah... Oh, “MEIKO's so pretty!”
And... “Does she ever not look good in red?!”

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Really? That's so sweet of them!
Please, feel free to keep posting more!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Since it's my anniversary today, I'd like to show everyone just how much I've grown.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Haha. Are you sure people won't get the wrong idea?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh... Did you hear that, MEIKO?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Yes, I certainly did.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
The wrong idea?
I hope you're not insinuating anything about my weight.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I mean, look at how I'm dressed.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. Things are really starting to heat up here, so shall we move on to our next song?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Sure! Next, we'll be doing two songs back to back!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: We'll start with a really cool one and follow it up with something a little more mature!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Right. I'm sure everyone will be excited to hear a lady like you sing that one, MEIKO.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I agree. They might just fall head over heels for you.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
H-Hold on, you guys...!
All these expectations are starting to make me nervous...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But I appreciate the thought, so again, I'd like to show everyone just how much I've grown.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: So without further ado!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Here we go!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: That was so much fun!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah! How about you guys? Did you have fun too?

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
Hehe. Thank you all so much!
This wouldn't have been possible without you!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: But sadly, this will be our last song...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Oh, before you do that, there's something we need to do.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Hehe. We've prepared some pre-finale messages for you as a little surprise.
song00010_off_s

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, MEIKO.
Your voice always finds a way to cheer me up and give me courage.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: And you've done so much for me outside of shows, so please feel free to ask me for help if you ever need it.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
I love shows so much!
Everything from the way you interact with everyone to your great reactions!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Hehe. I'm really looking forward to seeing more!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Thanks for helping Rin and I come up with ideas and trying them out!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: If possible, I'd like to pay you back somehow by helping you out in the same way.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So if you ever want to try out any new ideas, I'll be happy to help!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Happy anniversary, MEIKO.
Your strength is always so inspiring since you overcome obstacles so easily.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I hope you'll keep being the big sister I can rely on♪

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Doing an anniversary show like this with you, MEIKO, just makes me so happy.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Not only are you always incredibly cheerful, you're also very thoughtful of others. I'm sure that's why everyone is here celebrating with you today.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: So I hope you'll keep being the wonderful person you are.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Alright, everybody, one last time...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: One, two...!

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Happy anniversary, MEIKO!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I... I don't know what to say...
I might need a moment before I sing...

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Miku, all of you... Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I'll always be there for you!
I'm happy to help whenever you need me!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: *Nod*

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Thank you again for today, everyone!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I promise to make this year a good one and plan to sing as much as I can.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: And I'll start by singing a song that shows just how happy I feel right now...!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: I hope you enjoy the show and don't forget to stick around until the end!
